derivedBy: independent model pass (c): fresh-context read of git:parity-baseline:public/script.js only. No fixture and no other derivation was consulted.
backend: window.localStorage, origin-scoped — which is why the candidate must serve on http://localhost:7837 or every existing user config is orphaned (C3)

writtenBy: saveSettingsLocally (settings.serverPort is set by the settings dialog Save handler, before the POST /settings round-trip)
readBy: openSettingsDialog merges GET /settings over the parsed object
loadSettings().serverPort feeds --port and the ini port line

shape.serverPort: number, defaulted to DEFAULT_PORT 8080 by loadSettings when falsy
shape.modelsDirectory: string, present only after a GET /settings response has been merged into the object

keys.serialization: JSON.stringify(settings) with no spacing; key order follows insertion into the object, so a fresh browser writes serverPort first and modelsDirectory second

writtenBy: saveConfigurations, called by saveCurrentValues and by deleteConfiguration
readBy: launchModelPresets (re-reads localStorage directly rather than using the module state)
populateLaunchPresetsDropdown (also re-reads localStorage, only at DOMContentLoaded)
keys.shape: a plain object keyed by configuration name; each value is the saveCurrentValues literal — see persistedFields
keys.serialization: JSON.stringify(configurations) with no spacing; the object's own key order is the order in which names were first saved (or the order the previous JSON had, since parsing preserves it and deleting a key does not reorder the rest)

numberOrNaN.cacheRam: parseInt(cacheRamInput.value) with no || fallback: NaN serializes to null in JSON, which is how a cleared control is stored

rawStringTrap: minP/repeatPenalty/presencePenalty store value || 0, so a control holding '0.00' stores the STRING '0.00' while a control holding '0' stores number 0 — the three zero spellings coexist in real data (Q19) and the loose != "0" guards treat them differently

orphanKeys.fact: saveCurrentValues builds a brand-new object literal, so any key that is not one of the 36 is dropped the next time that configuration is saved (Q16). Reading never migrates or cleans them: loadConfiguration only looks at the 36 names plus the legacy branches below, and launchServer reads the DOM.
orphanKeys.observedInCorpus: 8 orphan keys across 28 of 48 configs: mlock, noMmap, ndio, dio, draftMin, draftMax, draftPMin, disableReasoning
legacyBranchesThatStillReadTwoOfThem: loadConfiguration: when config.loadMode is undefined it infers the value from mlock/noMmap/dio (dio > mmap+mlock > mlock > none > mmap)
loadConfiguration: when config.reasoning is undefined it maps disableReasoning true -> 'off', false -> 'on'
launchModelPresets: emits 'reasoning = off|on' from disableReasoning when reasoning is undefined (Q17)
loadConfiguration/launchModelPresets: config.specDraftNMax and config.ngramMod are consulted when speculationType is undefined
orphanKeys.candidateRule: neither migrate nor clean on load; only a user-initiated save may drop them, byte-for-byte as legacy does

insertionOrder.because: launchModelPresets iterates Object.entries(configs), so ini section order is localStorage insertion order, not alphabetical; the rendered list in #configList is separately .sort()ed, so list order and ini order legitimately differ (§9 trap 6)
insertionOrder.preservedBy: JSON.parse preserves document order and JSON.stringify re-emits it; delete + re-save of a DIFFERENT config keeps the remaining order, re-saving an existing name keeps its original position (assignment to an existing key does not move it)

setItem: llamaCppSettings in saveSettingsLocally (settings dialog Save, and nowhere else)

configNameRules.nameSource: configNameInput.value.trim(); an empty name alerts 'Please enter a configuration name' and saves nothing
configNameRules.overwrite: saving an existing name overwrites it and, because saveCurrentValues assigns into the parsed object, keeps its position in the insertion order
configNameRules.delete: confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete the configuration "<name>"?`) then delete + saveConfigurations + renderConfigList; if the deleted name was current, the hard-coded Q8 field reset runs
